items.title: Don Alias interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: First of all the Stone Alliance thing with Gene Perla... we were all just like close, crazy, wild friends... let's start a band together... I was designated the musical director... My friend Gene decided that he wanted to take some time off... so we had to disband then.

ctx.x: To hold up the bass end of things.
Well Gene, Gene of course was an excellent musician. Did you meet Gene? Do you know him?
I have not met him yet.
